title: Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park
summary: Permanent outdoor sculpture park within 16.5 acres of landscaped grounds at Pt. Leo Estate winery. 1.9km short walk (30 min) or 3km long walk (60 min) through world-class contemporary sculpture. Open daily 11am–5pm (last entry 4:30pm). Entry $15 adult, $8 concession, $30 family.
